ai_summary: Archean Chemical Industries reported strong Q1 FY27 sequential growth, with consolidated PAT more than doubling, driven by robust bromine volumes, improved realizations, and its derivatives business achieving EBITDA positivity for the first time. However, year-on-year margins were significantly pressured by escalating logistics costs and raw material prices, which adversely impacted industrial salt volumes and overall profitability. While management anticipates logistics improvements, the persistent reliance on external infrastructure, volatile freight rates, and geopolitical conflicts impacting key customer demand remain material concerns.
